title: Can I MASTER Infinite Chess?
summary: The creator returns to Infinite Chess (infinitechess.org: all chess rules the same but the board is infinite) to play its single-player checkmate practice levels rather than a full game. He uses drawn arrows, warms up with a queen + rook + knight vs lone king mate, then tries harder levels where unusual piece combinations must checkmate a king on an infinite board, working out the boxing-in configurations (cutting off files/ranks, anchoring pieces) and delivering the intended mates.
rules: Practice levels: player's specified pieces vs a lone black king; goal is to checkmate (no edges to use, so the king must be boxed in by your pieces).
Levels have difficulty tiers (easy -> hard); completed levels are marked.
win_condition: Deliver checkmate in each practice level.

board.theme_notes: Thumbnail: beige/brown infinite checker plane under a cosmic black-hole sky; white king on a red square ('Impossible mate?').

setup: Level 1: White Q+R+N (+K? not stated) vs lone black king on infinite board; later levels with other combinations (not fully enumerated in transcript).
current_impl_issues: Implemented as 'wrap' cylinder vs bot - wrong. Should be infinite-board checkmate practice levels (e.g. Q+R+N vs K).
evidence: Transcript 0:01 'all of the rules of chess are the same but the board is infinite... we can draw arrows... levels'; 0:29 'warm-up with the queen, the rook, and the knight'; 5:34 checkmate, move to harder levels; 10:35 deliver checkmate.
